description: Get everything needed to put a custom domain (e.g. yourshop.com) on a GearHost site: the exact DNS records, plus how to attach it. Identify the site by token, or by name+project_key. A custom domain can only be attached to a site in a GearHost account (it binds the domain to a real owner). The steps are: (1) the preview is claimed into a free account (claim_website or claim_url), (2) the domain is attached (attach_custom_domain when signed in, or "Attach Custom Domain" in the GearHost panel), (3) the DNS records are added at the domain's DNS host, (4) get_domain_status reports when it is live. Returns structuredContent { status, domain, claim_first, requires_account, attach_in_dashboard, claim_url, how_to_attach, records:[{ type, host, value, priority, note }], steps }.

domain.description: The custom domain to point here, e.g. "yourshop.com".

name.description: The site name (with project_key) instead of a token.

project_key.description: The project_key (with name) instead of a token.

token.description: The site manage token (or use name+project_key).

name: get_domain_setup

attach_in_dashboard.description: Always true — the attach itself is a click in Octane (Attach Custom Domain), not an API call.

claim_first.description: True if the site is not yet claimed — it must be claimed to an account before a custom domain can be attached.

claim_url.description: Surface this to the user to claim the site (one click if signed in). null if already claimed.

how_to_attach.description: A ready-to-relay walkthrough of the claim → attach → DNS → verify steps.

requires_account.description: Always true — attaching needs the owner's GearHost account; it is not API-automatable by design.

title: Get custom domain setup
